sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.

findings.why: The ASL is the complete controlled list for BR-220 at TO1 for STL. Meccanica C is approved only for BR-180 and BR-310, so it has no approval for BR-220. The supplier audit does not grant a part approval.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL CSR. A new material source needs a risk analysis and written STL approval before shipment. Offering 6061-T6 instead of the drawing's 6082-T6 also changes a drawing requirement. No STL approval is in the documents.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
Root cause not confirmed. A material-related contribution has not been excluded.

findings.why: Meccanica C has an open 8D on EN AW-6061-T6, the same alloy it now quotes for BR-220. BR-220 also has 4 fastener holes. The email of 2026-11-05 confirms the 8D stays open.

sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01
Rev B is superseded and withdrawn as of 2026-06-01.

findings.why: Drawing Rev C, which is in force, requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 of at least 250 MPa (SC-01). The offer is EN AW-6061-T6, a different grade. The email of 2026-11-05 cites 6061-T6 with 240 MPa, which is the withdrawn Rev B, so it cannot be relied on. Asserted 'equivalent' strength does not meet the grade requirement.

sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.

findings.why: There is no certificate or test result for Meccanica C's 6061-T6 billet showing Rp0.2 of at least 250 MPa. Only the supplier's verbal claim of equivalence exists. A person must obtain the EN 10204 3.1 certificate and tensile data.
